title: feat(nm2sreadslz): neighbor-read of 1-in 2-out split at t+1 on two-axis same-lock z-probes: reverse fails, face HOLD
science: Neighbor-read of the unsigned split on same-lock z-probes: fail at A (the aligned-seed artifact kills split there), HOLD at B,C,D. Its own text records that the verdict pair is identical to #7422's split-without-neighbor-read on the same cell, and that neighbor-read of signed M HOLDs at every z-probe while neighbor-read of signed O fails at every z-probe.
